title: eye of ender craft change
description: Changes the crafting recipe of the eye of ender. Changed recipe is composed of relics which can be crafted from materials that are all over the Minecraft world.
body: Changes the way to get the eyes of Ender. To get the eyes of Ender now, you must craft 8 relics. To craft each relic, you must use items from all around the Minecraft worlds. Once you collect all the relics, if  you hold them in your inventory, it will give you 64 Eyes of Ender.
